blocks.text: A fully managed digital presence and growth system: website, SEO, business email, analytics, social media, AI assistant and security, delivered and improved every month. blocks.text: Every plan carries every module: the tier changes how much you can have, never which parts of the system you may open. The first 30 days are free, billing is post-paid on each tenant's own 30-day cycle, and the limits are soft with a seven-day grace period — crossing one is an upgrade conversation, not a cut-off. A year paid up front is ten months' money for twelve months' service on every plan; it is arranged and invoiced once rather than switched on in the app, because the billing engine runs on 30-day cycles.

The naira list above was confirmed in October 2026 and replaces the earlier bands, which converted the plan's dollar tiers ($20, $50, $150) at a placeholder rate of 1,600 and had been going stale ever since. The per-extra-branch add-on was dropped with them: the Enterprise tier has no branch limit, and the billing engine only charges for branches beyond a limit, so that fee could never have been raised. The plan describes a shared multi-tenant SaaS; if the portfolio's single-deployment rule applies to Pursberry too, the Enterprise band becomes the dedicated-deployment offer. Decision
